title: Filter Characters by Frequency
summary: Given a string s of lowercase English letters and an integer k, create a new string containing only characters that appear fewer than k times in s, maintaining their original order.
statement: Given a string s of lowercase English letters and an integer k, create a new string containing only characters that appear fewer than k times in s, maintaining their original order. Return an empty string if no such characters exist.
constraints: Count every lowercase character in s.
Keep exactly the occurrences whose character appears fewer than k times overall.
hints: Build a global character frequency table.
Scan the original string in order.
Append a character only when its total count is strictly below k.
Joining retained occurrences preserves their source order.
editorial: Joining retained occurrences preserves their source order.
